COLD VACUUM WALK-THROUGH

Load, compare pressure, retrieve

  1. Open the door and load or import an inert rectangular coupon. The app screens it against its teaching holder, not the nominal chamber bore.
  2. Seat the door, run the cold draw, advance 12 simulated seconds, and inspect the trace.
  3. Hold, equalize, advance 40 simulated seconds, then open and unload. Export the original coupon ID and unchanged revision, modeled pressure, and event history.

The ambient reference (100 kPa), draw floor (20 kPa), time constants and equality guard are teaching choices. Nothing here applies plasma, changes a surface or provides a physical operating recipe.

Primary handbook, model and tests

Exact 230 V configuration: manufacturer handbook, Fig. 3 · Nominal dimensions. Published cabinet: 254 × 203.2 × 215.9 mm; nominal tube 76.2 × 165.1 mm. Viewer plug, hinge internals and holder are reconstructed; the optional pressure accessory is separate.

The solver uses dP/dt = (target − P)/τ, zero change during hold, and an explicitly synthetic terminal vent tolerance. Independent analytic reference at 12 s: normal 49.430355294 kPa, fast 30.826822659 kPa. No measured calibration or physical equilibrium/safety claims.

Input bts.inert-coupon.v1: sample ID, revision, size in mm and optional upstream history. Output bts.cold-vacuum-inspection.v1 and CSV trace in kPa absolute and elapsed virtual seconds. An absent accessory means the ideal accessory readout is null, not zero.
